entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
-And- Re: An application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. affirmed on 22.11.2016 in connection with Nandigram Police Station Case No.445/2015 dated 22.10.2015 under Section 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code, West Bengal Act of 42 of 1973, Section 3/328/304/120B of the Indian Penal Code,
Section 46AA of Bengal Excise Act and Section 16 (3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Indian Penal Code, West Bengal Act of 42 of 1973
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr. Amitabha Karmakar, Mr. Arup Kumar Bhowmick ...

Mr. A. A. Siddiqui .... For the State.
Heard the learned Advocates appearing on behalf of the parties.
The petitioner is in custody for 396 days.
It is the case of the prosecution that by consuming poisonous I.D.liquor, two persons died.

It appears that we granted bail to one of the co-accused, namely, Joydeb Bera on November 17, 2016 in connection with CRM No.9250 of 2016 essentially on the ground that no poison was detected in the viscera report.
The present petitioner may also be granted bail on the same footing as that of the said co-accused.
Having regard to above, we allow the petitioner's prayer for bail on parity.

Let the petitioner be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of Rs.5,000/- each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haldia.
The application for bail is, thus, disposed of.
